text:
Sherburne County had 75 providers holding active licenses in 2026
There were 75 licensed providers with active licenses in Sherburne County in 2026, the Minnesota Department of Human Services reported.
Among the license types shown publicly, Home and Community Based Services was the most common, with 42 active license records.
The total above includes all providers with active licenses. Some active licenses are included in the total but are not broken out by type or listed individually below because of privacy, sensitivity, reporting-threshold, or source-display rules.
